tellings.link_reason: Both relay Matt Pines's claim that Elizondo was a member of Gray Fox (the Intelligence Support Activity).

plain: A former Pentagon intelligence officer named Luis Elizondo was once a member of the US Army Intelligence Support Activity, a secretive Army intelligence unit also known as Gray Fox. Michels says this twice on the show, both times passing on a connection made by his friend Matthew Pines, a commentator who later came on as a guest. In one of the two tellings he places Elizondo's time in the unit in the 2000s. If true, it would mean Elizondo came from inside one of the military's most secretive units.
